```artifact
/* Finite State Machine (FSM) for the Alarm Subsystem */
states:
  Idle
  HighLeakageAlarm
  InvoluntaryShutdownAlarm
  ACMainLossAlarm

initial state: Idle

events:
  ComputeLeakageAverage
  DetectACMainLoss
  AlarmTimeout

guards:
  [HighLeakageGuard] (average_leakage > 3 L/min) for ComputeLeakageAverage
  [ACMainLossGuard] (ac_main_loss == true) for DetectACMainLoss

transitions:
  Idle --> HighLeakageAlarm : ComputeLeakageAverage{HighLeakageGuard}
  Idle --> ACMainLossAlarm : DetectACMainLoss{ACMainLossGuard}
  HighLeakageAlarm --> Idle : AlarmTimeout
  InvoluntaryShutdownAlarm --> Idle : AlarmTimeout
  ACMainLossAlarm --> Idle : AlarmTimeout

/* Additional details for InvoluntaryShutdownAlarm */
states:
  InvoluntaryShutdownAlarmActive
  InvoluntaryShutdownAlarmInactive

initial state: InvoluntaryShutdownAlarmActive

transitions:
  InvoluntaryShutdownAlarmActive --> InvoluntaryShutdownAlarmInactive : AlarmTimeout{timeout >= 2 min}
```
